newsitem.title: CHINA: China industrial accidents fall 13.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China industrial accidents fall 13.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: China reported 18,181 industrial accidents in 1996, down by 13.5 percent from the previous year, an official of the Ministry of Labour said on Wednesday.
A total of 17,231 people died in the accidents, dropping by 13.9 percent compared with 1995, the official said.
Of the total, 7,695 occurred in mining enterprises, down 6.2 percent from 1995, he said. Deaths in mine accidents were down 1.3 percent to 9,974 last year, he said.
Non-mining accidents totalled 10,486, down 12.2 percent compared with 1995, he said. Deaths in non-mining accidents declined by 10 percent to 7,257 last year.
Of the total accidents, 665 caused serious losses, up 2.8 percent from 1995, and resulted in 4,112 deaths, a rise of 11.1 percent, the official said but gave no further details.
